title: Calculator Step Definitions
description: Step-type-specific schema for CALCULATOR steps with operation field

CalcModifiedParameter.description: Modifiable parameters in calculator request payload

modifiedValue.description: New value to set for the modified parameter

jsonPath.description: JSON Path expression pointing to the field to modify (e.g. $.a, $.b)

modifiedValue.description: New value to set at the given jsonPath

validatedParameterValue.description: Expected value of the validated parameter

validationType.description: Type of validation: equal (exact match) or include (substring/element match)

jsonPath.description: JSON Path expression to extract value from response

validatedParameterDescription.description: Human-readable description of the validated parameter for reporting

operation.description: Calculator operation: 'add' for addition, 'multiply' for multiplication

stepName.description: Optional human-readable name for this step

stepInstanceName.description: Optional logical instance name for this stepType. Steps with the same stepType and stepInstanceName share module runtime state. Missing value uses the default instance.

hostRef.description: Reference to a host alias defined in config.yaml hosts map

stepType.description: Calculator step type - use additionalData.operation to specify add or multiply

dataHandlerName.description: Unique name for this step, used to reference this step's data sources from other steps

returnCode.description: Expected HTTP return code for this step

modifyRequests.description: List of modifications to apply to the calculator request payload

validateResponse.description: List of response parameter validations for this step
